meta.title: Cache request settings for Client
meta.body_summary: Precompute _headers and _timeout at client initialization and reuse them across requests; refresh headers when API key changes.

perf_labels.notes: Small-scope header/timeout caching refactor in langsmith SDK; merged with one empty APPROVED review and no performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 60 changed lines, this is a very small edit by absolute volume. It fits a small-step, low-risk performance PR and is consistent with the fast, low-friction merge.

review_details.concern_detail: The only review (by hinthornw) was APPROVED with an empty body; no performance concerns, correctness issues, or design feedback were recorded.
review_details.performance_claim: Caching _headers and _timeout at client init to avoid repeated computation per request.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Caching in a Python SDK client is a straightforward optimization that requires no benchmark or performance evidence in this repo context; merged quickly with minimal review.

core_change_summary.description: In python/langsmith/client.py, compute _headers and _timeout once during Client initialization instead of per-request, and refresh _headers when API key changes. Unit tests updated in test_client.py.
